description:
The US Army Installation and Management Command (Army-IMCOM), US Army Installation Directorate-Sustainment (ID-Sustainment) Brigade requires a service agreement for comprehensive cleaning of kitchen exhaust systems and dryer vents at three locations: Fort Myer, Henderson Hall, and Fort McNair. The primary objectives are to prevent fire hazards, maintain equipment, and ensure a safe environment for personnel by removing grease, lint, and other contaminants in compliance with all applicable safety and fire-prevention standards. There are no mandatory source requirements or available contract vehicles for this need. Additional customers may include other components of the United States Coast Guard, Department of the Air Force, and Department of the Army. 

 See attached PWS
